appearance_facts.fact: Title reads 'Preferred Mode of Transport in Region R'. A pie chart occupies the central area. A two-item legend sits at top-right.
A light grey slice is the larger portion, visually spanning roughly the right half plus more, with a white '58%' label inside it.
A red slice is the smaller portion, with a white '42%' label inside it.
Red square is bound to 'Car'; light grey square is bound to 'Public Transit'.

printed_facts.fact: Preferred Mode of Transport in Region R

public_definitions: Choose the transport mode that should enter majority-preference policy follow-up.
Options: Route Public Transit to majority-preference policy follow-up; Route Car to majority-preference policy follow-up; Send regional transport preference record to routine monitoring.
uncertain: No ambiguity: the 58% grey slice is bound to Public Transit and exceeds 50%, making it the majority-share mode.
